title: Tier 2 nightly workflow
summary: .github/workflows/benchmark-nightly.yml — scheduled + dispatchable, 50k-row corpus, full matrix + Locust ramp + selectivity sweep + IR metrics + memray checks, opens an issue on regression.
description:
Write `.github/workflows/benchmark-nightly.yml`, scheduled (`0 3 * * *`) and `workflow_dispatch`-able against a 50k-row/50-scope corpus in the Db2 container: the full `pytest -m benchmark` matrix across all P0/P1 capabilities, BM-14's Locust ramp (1->50 users, 15 min, mixed 70/30 read/write with leak assertions), BM-15's pool-saturation sweep, BM-23's filter-selectivity sweep with `MON_GET_PKG_CACHE_STMT` capture, an APPROX-vs-EXACT recall check at 50k rows, BM-17's deterministic IR metrics on `longmemeval_s`, and BM-6's memray peak-RSS checks on `export_scope()`/deep `list_all()`. Push results to `gh-pages` and open a labelled issue on any regression.

Acceptance: completes within a 2-hour budget; results are published to `gh-pages`; a regression opens a labelled GitHub issue automatically; `workflow_dispatch` accepts corpus-size and scenario inputs so it can be run ad hoc, not just on schedule. Depends on BM-20, BM-14, and BM-17.

comments.text: .github/workflows/benchmark-nightly.yml created: single-job workflow scheduled at 0 3 * * * and workflow_dispatch-able with corpus_size (default 50k) and scenario (full/locust/ir-metrics) inputs. concurrency: benchmark-nightly-${{ github.ref }}, cancel-in-progress: true except for manual dispatch. Db2 container setup verbatim from ci.yml (docker-compose.db2-nightly.yml, DDL readiness probe, LOGFILSIZ 4096 expansion). Steps: seed_corpus.py --size ${CORPUS_SIZE} --seed 42 (skipped for ir-metrics scenario); pytest -m 'benchmark_micro or benchmark_pr' writes output_benchmark.json; BM-14 MixedReadWriteUser 50 VUs 15 min 70/30 --fail-ratio 0.01 (skipped for ir-metrics); BM-15 pool-saturation quick pass at pool=5 and pool=20 (skipped for ir-metrics); BM-17 benchmark_nightly suite with benchmark_micro fallback when BM-17 is not yet implemented (skipped for locust). Results published to gh-pages benchmarks/nightly/<run_number>/. Regression issue opened via actions/github-script@v7 on failure. 120 min timeout.
